title: Projector HD For Home Theater Office 360 Degree Rotatable PTZ Portable Mini HY320 AU Plug 110‑220V Black
body_html: 1、HD IMAGE: The HY320 projector use advanced projection technology to achieve highdefinition image effects, making videos and images more clear and vivid 2、ROTATABLE PROJECTOR: The projector has a turret design, which can be rotated 360 degrees and adjusted up and down, which is convenient to flexibly adjust the projection angle to meet the needs of different occasion 3、COMPACT AND PORTABLE: The compact and lightweight design make the projector easy to carry, suitable for home, office and travel use, enjoy a movie like sound visual experience anytime and anywhere 4、HOME THEATER EFFECT: The projector support a variety of multimedia connection methods, which can be connected with computers, mobile phones, tablets and other devices to create a private home theater and share wonderful movies and TV dramas 5、MULTIFUNCTIONAL APPLICATION: The projector can not only be used to watch movies, TV series and other entertainment content, but also can be used for office demonstrations, education and training and other occasion to meet different needsItem Type: ProjectorMaterial: ABSWeight: 1087 g / 38.3 oz(approx.)1 x Projector
